title.zh-CN: 持续发热与嗜睡 · 34日龄女婴
title.en: Persistent fever and drowsiness · girl aged 34 days

summary.zh-CN: 小婴儿抗感染后仍持续发热，既往短暂眼红口唇红容易被忽略；需结合心脏、脑脊液及炎症证据。
summary.en: A young infant remains febrile after antibiotics; brief earlier eye and lip redness may be overlooked, requiring cardiac, CSF and inflammatory evidence to be integrated.

text.zh-CN: 原报告用静脉免疫球蛋白、阿司匹林及甘露醇等治疗，2天后退热，住院11天出院；出院时血小板915×10⁹/L、CRP 20.9 mg/L。病程始终未出现指趾脱皮。2个月后冠脉无明显改善；半年时右冠4.2 mm、左冠2.8 mm且动脉导管关闭。3岁3个月时生长发育及神经检查正常，左冠正常，右冠仍3.4 mm、内膜欠光滑，继续随访。历史长期阿司匹林剂量不作为本教学推荐。
text.en: The report used IV immunoglobulin, aspirin, mannitol and supportive care. Fever resolved in two days and discharge followed 11 hospital days, with platelets 915×10⁹/L and CRP 20.9 mg/L. Digital peeling never appeared. Coronary changes persisted at two months; at six months the right coronary artery was 4.2 mm and left 2.8 mm, with ductal closure. At age 3 years 3 months growth, development and neurological examination were normal; the left coronary artery was normal but the right remained 3.4 mm with irregular intima, requiring continued follow-up. Historical long-term aspirin doses are not recommended by this teaching case.

prompt.zh-CN: 持续发热和冠脉结果如何整合？
prompt.en: How should persistent fever and coronary findings be integrated?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 考虑不完全川崎病，报告并诊无菌性脑膜炎；同时保留小婴儿感染评估
text.en: Consider incomplete Kawasaki disease; the report also diagnosed aseptic meningitis, while maintaining infection evaluation in this young infant

feedback.zh-CN: 早期黏膜症状、持续发热、明显炎症及冠脉异常构成关键证据；脑脊液蛋白改变和阴性培养需结合临床与抗菌药背景解释。
feedback.en: Earlier mucosal symptoms, persistent fever, marked inflammation and coronary abnormalities form the key evidence; CSF protein and negative cultures require clinical and antibiotic-context interpretation.

text.zh-CN: 没有皮疹或当前眼红即可排除川崎病，且培养阴性足以排除感染
text.en: Absent rash or current eye redness excludes Kawasaki disease, and negative cultures exclude infection

feedback.zh-CN: 早期黏膜症状、持续发热、明显炎症及冠脉异常构成关键证据；脑脊液蛋白改变和阴性培养需结合临床与抗菌药背景解释。
feedback.en: Earlier mucosal symptoms, persistent fever, marked inflammation and coronary abnormalities form the key evidence; CSF protein and negative cultures require clinical and antibiotic-context interpretation.

prompt.zh-CN: 应如何制定安全的治疗与复查计划？
prompt.en: How should a safe treatment and review plan be arranged?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 由儿科心脏团队评估免疫治疗和冠脉风险，按当前体重及风险制定抗血小板方案并连续超声随访
text.en: Paediatric cardiology assessment of immunotherapy and coronary risk, with weight/risk-based antiplatelet planning and serial echocardiography

feedback.zh-CN: 历史阿司匹林剂量不是当前处方；冠脉绝对径不能在身高未知时自行转换成Z值，持续异常需要专科随访。
feedback.en: Historical aspirin doses are not current prescriptions; coronary diameters cannot be converted into Z scores without missing size data, and persistent abnormalities require specialist follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 把原文多年递增的阿司匹林固定剂量直接用于今天所有婴儿
text.en: Copy the report’s progressively increased fixed aspirin doses for all infants today

feedback.zh-CN: 历史阿司匹林剂量不是当前处方；冠脉绝对径不能在身高未知时自行转换成Z值，持续异常需要专科随访。
feedback.en: Historical aspirin doses are not current prescriptions; coronary diameters cannot be converted into Z scores without missing size data, and persistent abnormalities require specialist follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 重建症状与用药时间线
text.en: Reconstruct the symptom and medication timeline

text.zh-CN: 形成安全计划并复盘转归
text.en: Form a safe plan and review the outcome

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 入院时是34日龄婴儿，发病约在24日龄；冠脉异常及早期黏膜线索支持报告的不完全川崎病诊断，远期右冠仍异常。
conclusion.en: The infant was 34 days old at admission, with onset around day 24; coronary changes and earlier mucosal clues support the reported incomplete Kawasaki diagnosis, with persistent right-coronary abnormality later.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 症状可能短暂出现，初诊体检阴性不能抹去早期病史。
keyReasoning.en: Transient symptoms can disappear; a negative current examination does not erase earlier history.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 退热不代表冠脉病变已经消失。
keyReasoning.en: Resolution of fever does not mean coronary lesions have resolved.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出生史、入院身高和冠脉Z值、完整病原排查及更长期冠脉结局。
unknowns.en: Birth history, admission height/coronary Z scores, complete pathogen evaluation and longer-term coronary outcome.
